title: Minimum Length of String After Deleting Similar Ends
summary: Given a string s made up of 'a', 'b', and 'c', repeatedly remove matching non-empty prefixes and suffixes of equal characters that do not overlap.
statement: Given a string s made up of 'a', 'b', and 'c', repeatedly remove matching non-empty prefixes and suffixes of equal characters that do not overlap. Return the shortest possible string length after any number of such operations.
constraints: In one operation, if both ends share a character, delete any positive prefix and suffix made only of that character without overlap.
Return the minimum remaining length after repeated operations.
hints: Whenever endpoints match, deleting their complete same-character runs can never reduce future options.
Use two pointers and repeatedly skip the shared character from both ends.
While left<right and endpoints match, remember the character and advance each pointer across its run.
Any legal operation removes subsets of those same outer runs; removing them fully reaches the same interior with no extra cost.
editorial: Any legal operation removes subsets of those same outer runs; removing them fully reaches the same interior with no extra cost.

tests.explanation: The end characters differ, so no deletion is possible and length two remains.
Delete the outer c runs, then a runs, then b runs; nothing remains.
